title: Clane
html_source:
Clane is a town in County Kildare, Ireland, about 20 miles from Dublin. In this town is Clongowes Wood College—the school that Stephen attends—and it is run by the Jesuit Fathers.

James Joyce is a notable alumni of Clongowes Wood College.
